'''Kabal Station''' was an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Attack on Kabal Station|unsuccessfully attacked]] the station during the conflict.<ref name="TOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
